dlc.title: Back to the Future Special Pack

roadmap.title: Career route
roadmap.description: Follow the Career jobs in order, earning stars and buying equipment. Do each job-specific challenge before finishing its job. Replay failed attempts in Free Play.

roadmap.title: Gold challenges
roadmap.description: Earn gold on five different Time or Water challenges.

roadmap.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
roadmap.description: Finish the six Special Pack jobs and their cleaning-order challenges.

roadmap.title: Back to the Future
roadmap.description: Complete the five film-set jobs and their optional tasks. Stay after cleaning the Time Machine to watch its return.

roadmap.title: Warhammer 40,000
roadmap.description: Clean the five Imperial machines, handling the restricted objects and yellow-nozzle job first.

roadmap.title: Alice’s Adventures
roadmap.description: Complete the five Wonderland jobs and their optional interactions and cleaning restrictions.

roadmap.title: Shrek
roadmap.description: Complete the five fairy-tale jobs and finish each optional task during its matching job.

roadmap.title: Wallace & Gromit
roadmap.description: Complete the five jobs, activate the inventions and handle the specified objects before finishing each job.

achievements.description: Own all cleaning liquids at the same time
achievements.summary: Own at least one bottle of each of the six cleaning liquids at once.

steps.text: Use the tablet shop to buy one bottle each: Wood Cleaner 1L, Glass Cleaner 1L, Stone Cleaner 1L, Metal Cleaner 1L, Multi-Purpose Cleaner 1L and Plastic Cleaner 1L. Keep the six bottles in your inventory.

achievements.description: Own the Prime Vista 1500 and three of its attachments
achievements.summary: Own a Prime Vista 1500 with at least three attachments.

steps.text: Keep the free @item{Prime Vista 1500 Extra Long Extension}, then buy its Turbo Nozzle for $15 and Short Extension for $25 from the tablet shop.

achievements.description: Own the UrbanX U2 and four of its attachments
achievements.summary: Own an UrbanX U2 with at least four attachments.

steps.text: Buy the @item{UrbanX U2} and four matching attachments from the tablet shop. The Turbo Nozzle, Short Extension, Long Extension and Soap Nozzle give the cheapest set, costing $1,725 including the washer.

achievements.description: Own the Prime Vista 3000 and five of its attachments
achievements.summary: Own a Prime Vista 3000 with all five attachments.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Prime Vista 3000}, Turbo Nozzle, Short Extension, Long Extension, Soap Nozzle and Extra Long Extension from the tablet shop. The complete set costs $4,120.

achievements.description: Own the Prime Vista PRO and six of its attachments
achievements.summary: Own a Prime Vista PRO with all six attachments.

guide.context: The @item{Triple Tip Nozzle} unlocks at 165 Career stars.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Prime Vista PRO} and these attachments: Triple Tip Nozzle, Turbo Nozzle, Soap Nozzle, Short Extension, Extra Long Extension and Long Extension. The complete set costs $10,580.

achievements.description: Equip a new outfit, gloves and washer modification at the same time
achievements.summary: Equip a purchased outfit, gloves and washer skin together in a job.

steps.text: Buy an outfit, gloves and a washer modification from the tablet shop; the cheapest combination costs $125.
Equip the outfit and gloves, then open Loadout and use the theme icon on the washer selection to equip its purchased skin. Enter a job wearing the complete set.

achievements.description: Completely clean the Van using only the red nozzle
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning the Van using only the red 0° nozzle.

guide.context: Spraying with another nozzle fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Van} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Equip the @item{red 0° nozzle} before spraying the Van and use that nozzle until the job is finished. The Triple Tip Nozzle does not count.

achievements.description: In the Back Garden, complete all 12 stepping stones first
achievements.summary: Clean all 12 Back Garden stepping stones before completing any other object.

guide.context: Completing any other object first fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Back Garden} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish the 12 @item{Stepping Stones} in @loc{Back Garden} before any other object reaches 100%.

achievements.description: In the Playground, roll the football up the stegoslide
achievements.summary: Roll the Playground football over the top of the stegoslide.

guide.context: If the job ends before the ball crosses the slide, replay @loc{Playground} in Free Play.

steps.text: Use the washer to push the football up the @loc{Playground} stegoslide until the ball passes over the top. Place the step stool as a barrier if the ball keeps rolling away.

achievements.description: Complete the Bungalow gutters last
achievements.summary: Finish the Bungalow with all four gutters as the last objects cleaned.

guide.context: Finishing a protected object too early fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Bungalow} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish every object in @loc{Bungalow} except the four @item{Gutters}.
Clean the four @item{Gutters} to finish the job.

achievements.description: In the Detached House, complete the Pathway, Driveway and Driveway Edges first
achievements.summary: Clean the Detached House pathway, driveway and both driveway edges before completing any other object.

guide.context: Completing any other object first fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Detached House} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish @item{Pathway}, @item{Driveway} and both @item{Driveway Edges} before completing anything else in @loc{Detached House}.

achievements.description: Complete the sole of the Shoe House last
achievements.summary: Finish the Shoe House with the sole as the last object cleaned.

guide.context: Finishing a protected object too early fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Shoe House} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish every object in @loc{Shoe House} except the @item{Sole}.
Clean the @item{Sole} to finish the job.

achievements.description: Completely clean the Fire Station job without standing on the scaffolding
achievements.summary: Finish the Fire Station without standing on the scaffolding.

guide.context: Stepping onto the scaffolding fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Fire Station} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Clean the entire @loc{Fire Station} while staying off the scaffolding. Use the ladder and step stool to reach the roof.

achievements.description: In the Skatepark, push the ball out of the bowl
achievements.summary: Push the Skatepark ball out of the bowl.

guide.context: If the job ends with the ball still in the bowl, replay @loc{Skatepark} in Free Play.

steps.text: Spray the ball in the middle bowl of @loc{Skatepark} with the @item{red nozzle} until the ball goes over the bowl’s rim.

achievements.description: Complete the Fire Truck windows, windscreen and wing mirrors first
achievements.summary: Clean the Fire Truck’s windscreen, six windows and two wing mirrors before completing any other object.

guide.context: Completing any other object first fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Fire Truck} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish the @item{Wind Screen}, six @item{Windows} and two @item{Wing Mirrors}. Keep both windscreen wipers unfinished.

achievements.description: Stand on the Penny Farthing for 10 seconds
achievements.summary: Remain atop the Penny Farthing bicycle for 10 seconds.

guide.context: If the job ends before you finish balancing, replay @loc{Penny Farthing} in Free Play.

steps.text: Jump onto the @item{Penny Farthing} in its job and remain on the bicycle for 10 seconds.

achievements.description: In the Treehouse, complete all of the lanterns first
achievements.summary: Clean all 12 Treehouse lanterns before completing any other object.

guide.context: Completing any other object first fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Treehouse} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish all 12 @item{Lanterns}: two on the entrance posts, one hanging above the research table at the second landing, eight under the house roof and one at the foot of the spiral stairs.

achievements.description: Complete the Fire Helicopter blades first
achievements.summary: Clean the Fire Helicopter’s six rotor blades and four tail rotor blades before completing any other object.

guide.context: Completing any other object first fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Fire Helicopter} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish all six @item{Rotor Blades} and all four @item{Tail Rotor Blades} before completing another Fire Helicopter object.

achievements.description: Completely clean the Carousel without turning it off
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning the Carousel without switching the ride off.

guide.context: Turning the ride off fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Carousel} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Leave the Carousel running and clean the entire job without using its stop controls.

achievements.description: In the Temple, ensure the gnome is on the tower roof once the job is complete
achievements.summary: Finish the Temple while the gnome is on the highest tower roof.

guide.context: Finishing with the gnome off the tower roof fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Temple} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Keep the gnome on the @loc{Temple}’s highest roof, or pick the gnome up and return it there before cleaning the final object.
Finish cleaning the Temple with the gnome still on that roof.

achievements.description: In the Washroom, complete the toilets, toilet seats and toilet lids last
achievements.summary: Finish the Washroom with the four toilets, four toilet seats and four toilet lids as the last objects cleaned.

guide.context: Finishing a protected object too early fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Washroom} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish every object in @loc{Washroom} except the four @item{Toilets}, four @item{Toilet Seats} and four @item{Toilet Lids}.
Clean the four @item{Toilets}, four @item{Toilet Seats} and four @item{Toilet Lids} to finish the job.

achievements.description: On the Helter Skelter, complete the objects that have lightbulbs before anything else
achievements.summary: Clean every lightbulb-bearing object on the Helter Skelter before completing any other object.

guide.context: Completing any other object first fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Helter Skelter} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish the whole @item{Sign}, @item{Top Ring Frame} and all 16 @item{Channel Lights}. Cleaning only the bulbs is insufficient.

achievements.description: Complete the Private Jet laser and anti-gravity parts first
achievements.summary: Clean the Private Jet’s laser and anti-gravity parts before completing any other object.

guide.context: Completing any other object first fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Private Jet} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish @item{Laser}, both @item{Anti-Gravity Boosters} and both @item{Anti-Gravity Panels}. Leave the separate Laser Mount unfinished.

achievements.description: Complete the Monster Truck tyres first
achievements.summary: Clean all four Monster Truck tyres before completing any other object.

guide.context: Completing any other object first fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Monster Truck} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish the four @item{Tyre} objects. Leave @item{Wheel Outer} and @item{Wheel Inner} objects unfinished.

achievements.description: Ride around the Big Wheel with a gnome
achievements.summary: Ride the Ferris Wheel with the gnome.

guide.context: If the job ends before the ride, replay @loc{Ferris Wheel} in Free Play.

steps.text: In the @loc{Ferris Wheel} job, collect the gnome at the summit of the Helter Skelter slide.
Enter a Ferris Wheel car while carrying the gnome and stay aboard with the gnome until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: In the Subway Platform, complete the advertising boards first
achievements.summary: Clean all eight Subway Platform advertising boards before completing any other object.

guide.context: Completing any other object first fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Subway Platform} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish the eight wall-mounted @item{Advertising Boards}, four on each side of @loc{Subway Platform}, before completing anything else.

achievements.description: At the Ancient Statue, knock over four buckets
achievements.summary: Move each of the four blue buckets at the Ancient Statue with the washer.

guide.context: Use the @item{red 0° nozzle} to move the buckets. If the job ends before all four move, replay @loc{Ancient Statue} in Free Play.

steps.text: From the entrance, count the tents along the left side. Spray the blue bucket beneath the second tent, then the blue bucket beside a red bucket beneath the farther tent near the movable scaffolding.
Move the blue bucket on a box under the tent up the hill behind the statue, then the blue bucket on top of the scaffolding behind the statue’s head.

achievements.description: Completely clean the Ancient Monument using only the white nozzle
achievements.summary: Clean the whole Ancient Monument with the white nozzle exclusively.

guide.context: Spraying with another nozzle fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Ancient Monument} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Equip the @item{white nozzle} before spraying and keep using it until the @loc{Ancient Monument} job is finished. Choose the hand-shaped monument, rather than Ancient Statue.

achievements.description: Complete the Fishing Boat bow, steps and main deck first
achievements.summary: Clean the Fishing Boat’s bow, main deck and two steps before completing any other object.

guide.context: Completing any other object first fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Fishing Boat} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish @item{Bow}, @item{Main Deck} and both @item{Steps}. Keep the Bridge Deck and Roof Deck unfinished.

achievements.description: Complete Career Mode
achievements.summary: Finish every job in Career Mode.

steps.text: Finish the Career jobs through @loc{Lost City Palace}, the final Career job.

achievements.description: At the Fairground, knock over all of the coconuts
achievements.summary: Move each of the five coconuts at the Fairground shooting gallery with the washer.

guide.context: If the job ends before all five coconuts move, replay @loc{Ferris Wheel} in Free Play.

steps.text: In the @loc{Ferris Wheel} job, spray all five coconuts in the shooting gallery behind the Ferris Wheel.

achievements.description: Earn 5 Stars in Career Mode
achievements.summary: Accumulate 5 stars in Career Mode.

steps.text: Complete Career jobs until your star total reaches 5. A fully cleaned job awards five stars.

achievements.description: Earn 50 Stars Career Mode
achievements.summary: Accumulate 50 stars in Career Mode.

steps.text: Complete Career jobs until your star total reaches 50. A fully cleaned job awards five stars.

achievements.description: Earn 100 Stars in Career Mode
achievements.summary: Accumulate 100 stars in Career Mode.

steps.text: Complete Career jobs until your star total reaches 100. A fully cleaned job awards five stars.

achievements.description: Earn 150 Stars in Career Mode
achievements.summary: Accumulate 150 stars in Career Mode.

steps.text: Complete Career jobs until your star total reaches 150. A fully cleaned job awards five stars.

achievements.description: Clean 95% of any job without completing any tasks
achievements.summary: Reach 95% cleanliness on one job without completing any individual object.

guide.context: Completing even one object fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Van} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: On the @loc{Van}, spread the cleaning across the body and smaller parts without letting any object reach 100%. Stop once total job cleanliness reaches 95%.

achievements.description: Complete the Drill head and tip first
achievements.summary: Clean the Drill’s head and tip before completing any other object.

guide.context: Completing any other object first fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Drill} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish @item{Drill Head} and @item{Drill Tip} before completing any other part of the Drill.

achievements.description: Get one gold medal in Challenge Mode
achievements.summary: Earn a gold medal in one Challenge Mode challenge.

steps.text: Open Challenges on the tablet and earn gold in a Time Challenge or Water Challenge.

achievements.description: Get five gold medals in Challenge Mode
achievements.summary: Earn gold medals in five distinct Challenge Mode challenges.

steps.text: Earn gold in five different Time or Water challenges from the tablet’s Challenges section. Replaying an already gold-rated challenge adds no new medal.

achievements.description: Complete a Bonus Job
achievements.summary: Finish one Bonus Job.

steps.text: Choose @loc{Mars Rover} from Bonus Jobs and clean the entire job.

achievements.description: Complete the Conch Street job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning Conch Street.

steps.text: Clean every object in @loc{Conch Street} in the SpongeBob SquarePants Special Pack.

achievements.description: Complete the Bikini Bottom Bus job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning Bikini Bottom Bus.

steps.text: Clean every object in @loc{Bikini Bottom Bus} in the SpongeBob SquarePants Special Pack.

achievements.description: Complete the Krusty Krab job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning Krusty Krab.

steps.text: Clean every object in @loc{Krusty Krab} in the SpongeBob SquarePants Special Pack.

achievements.description: Complete the Patty Wagon job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning Patty Wagon.

steps.text: Clean every object in @loc{Patty Wagon} in the SpongeBob SquarePants Special Pack.

achievements.description: Complete the Invisible Boatmobile job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning Invisible Boatmobile.

steps.text: Clean every object in @loc{Invisible Boatmobile} in the SpongeBob SquarePants Special Pack.

achievements.description: Complete the Mermalair job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning Mermalair.

steps.text: Clean every object in @loc{Mermalair} in the SpongeBob SquarePants Special Pack.

achievements.displayName: It's not a Boulder, It's a Rock!
achievements.description: In the Conch Street job, complete Patrick's Rock, Rock Hinge and Rock Underside last
achievements.summary: Finish Conch Street with Patrick’s rock, rock hinge and rock underside as the last objects cleaned.

guide.context: Finishing a protected object too early fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Conch Street} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish every object in @loc{Conch Street} except @item{Patrick’s House - Rock}, @item{Patrick’s House - Rock Hinge} and @item{Patrick’s House - Rock Underside}.
Clean @item{Patrick’s House - Rock}, @item{Patrick’s House - Rock Hinge} and @item{Patrick’s House - Rock Underside} to finish the job.

achievements.description: In the Krusty Krab job, complete the Chum Bucket first
achievements.summary: Clean the entire Chum Bucket in the Krusty Krab job before completing any other object.

guide.context: Completing any other object first fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Krusty Krab} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish every object whose name starts with @item{Chum Bucket}: both Doors, both Door Handles, both Door Windows, Floor, Glove, both Handles, both Handle Pins, ten Letters, Lower Rim, Upper Rim, Roof and both Walls.

achievements.description: In the Patty Wagon job, complete the Pickles first
achievements.summary: Clean all four Patty Wagon pickles before completing any other object.

guide.context: Completing any other object first fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Patty Wagon} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: Finish all four @item{Pickles} on the Patty Wagon. Clean the connecting axles too; they belong to the Pickles objects.

achievements.description: In the Mermalair job, complete Patrick's Identity Card first
achievements.summary: Clean Patrick’s Identity Card in the Mermalair before completing any other object.

guide.context: Completing any other object first fails this attempt. Replay @loc{Mermalair} in Free Play to retry.

steps.text: At the Chemistry Lab Table, look across the right half for @item{Patrick’s Identity Card}. Clean the card before completing any other object.

achievements.description: Complete the Doc Brown's Van job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Doc Brown's Van}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Doc Brown's Van} to 100% clean.

achievements.description: Complete the Time Machine job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Time Machine}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Time Machine} to 100% clean.

achievements.description: Complete the Clocktower job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Clocktower}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Clocktower} to 100% clean.

achievements.displayName: 2015? You Mean We're in the Future?
achievements.description: Complete the Holomax Theater job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Holomax Theater}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Holomax Theater} to 100% clean.

achievements.displayName: Your Future is Whatever You Make it
achievements.description: Complete the Doc's Time Train job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Doc's Time Train}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Doc's Time Train} to 100% clean.

achievements.description: Watch the Time Machine reappear
achievements.summary: Watch the @item{Time Machine} return after completing its cleaning job.

guide.context: Leaving before the return loses this visit; replay @loc{Time Machine} in Free Play and stay after cleaning.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Time Machine}, then stay in the scene for about one minute until the DeLorean reappears.

achievements.displayName: May it Stand for All Time!
achievements.description: In the Clocktower job, ring the bell
achievements.summary: Sound the bell in @loc{Clocktower}.

guide.context: Leaving without ringing the bell requires another visit to @loc{Clocktower} in Free Play.

steps.text: Inside @loc{Clocktower}, climb the staircase on your right as you enter.
At the top, interact with the @item{Clock Hammer} to sound the bell.

achievements.description: In the Holomax Theater Job, activate the holographic shark
achievements.summary: Trigger the holographic shark at @loc{Holomax Theater} and watch the full animation.

guide.context: Leaving before the animation ends loses this visit; replay @loc{Holomax Theater} in Free Play.

steps.text: Stand on the @loc{red X} outside @loc{Holomax Theater} until the shark animation ends.

achievements.description: In the Holomax Theater job, clean the Grid Wall first
achievements.summary: Make the @item{Grid Wall} the first object fully cleaned at @loc{Holomax Theater}.

guide.context: Completing an unrelated object too early fails this attempt; replay @loc{Holomax Theater} in Free Play. Partial overspray does not count as completing an object.

steps.text: Finish cleaning the @item{Grid Wall} before completing any other object.

achievements.displayName: This is What Makes Time Travel Possible
achievements.description: In the Doc's Time Train job, clean the Flux Capacitor and its Particle Colliders first
achievements.summary: Make the @item{Flux Capacitor} and its three @item{Particle Colliders} the first four objects fully cleaned on @loc{Doc's Time Train}.

guide.context: Completing an unrelated object too early fails this attempt; replay @loc{Doc's Time Train} in Free Play. Partial overspray does not count as completing an object.

steps.text: At the front of the engine car, clean the @item{Flux Capacitor} and all three @item{Flux Capacitor Particle Colliders} before completing another object.
Leave the surrounding @warn{Flux Capacitor Housing} unfinished until those four targets are clean.

achievements.description: Complete the Land Raider job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Land Raider}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Land Raider} to 100% clean.

achievements.description: Complete the Redemptor Dreadnought job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Redemptor Dreadnought}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Redemptor Dreadnought} to 100% clean.

achievements.description: Complete the Rogal Dorn Battle Tank job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Rogal Dorn Battle Tank}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Rogal Dorn Battle Tank} to 100% clean.

achievements.description: Complete the Imperial Knight Paladin job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Imperial Knight Paladin}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Imperial Knight Paladin} to 100% clean.

achievements.description: Complete the Thunderhawk job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Thunderhawk}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Thunderhawk} to 100% clean.

achievements.description: In the Land Raider job, complete the "Ultramarines II" Plaque first
achievements.summary: Make the @item{Ultramarines II Plaque} the first object fully cleaned on @loc{Land Raider}.

guide.context: Completing an unrelated object too early fails this attempt; replay @loc{Land Raider} in Free Play. Partial overspray does not count as completing an object.

steps.text: Clean the @item{Ultramarines II Plaque} completely before finishing another object.

achievements.description: Completely clean the Redemptor Dreadnought using only the yellow nozzle
achievements.summary: Clean the entire @loc{Redemptor Dreadnought} with the @mechanic{yellow nozzle} alone.

guide.context: Removing dirt with a different nozzle fails this attempt; replay @loc{Redemptor Dreadnought} in Free Play with yellow only.

steps.text: Fit the @mechanic{yellow nozzle} before removing any dirt, then keep using yellow until the job is complete.

achievements.description: In the Imperial Knight Paladin job, complete the Tilt Shield and Tilt Shield Purity Seals first
achievements.summary: Make the @item{Tilt Shield} and its three @item{Purity Seals} the first four objects fully cleaned on @loc{Imperial Knight Paladin}.

guide.context: Completing an unrelated object too early fails this attempt; replay @loc{Imperial Knight Paladin} in Free Play. Partial overspray does not count as completing an object.

steps.text: Clean the @item{Tilt Shield} and the three @item{Tilt Shield Purity Seals} on its front before completing another object.

achievements.description: In the Rogal Dorn Battle Tank job, complete the Stowed Shovel first
achievements.summary: Make the @item{Stowed Shovel} the first object fully cleaned on @loc{Rogal Dorn Battle Tank}.

guide.context: Completing an unrelated object too early fails this attempt; replay @loc{Rogal Dorn Battle Tank} in Free Play. Partial overspray does not count as completing an object.

steps.text: Use the @mechanic{red nozzle} to finish the @item{Stowed Shovel} without completing the nearby @warn{Small Stowed Cloth Roll}.

achievements.displayName: Descend into Shadow, Rise into Light
achievements.description: In the Thunderhawk Job, complete the Retro Thrusters first
achievements.summary: Make all 16 @item{Retro Thrusters} the first objects fully cleaned on @loc{Thunderhawk}.

guide.context: Completing an unrelated object too early fails this attempt; replay @loc{Thunderhawk} in Free Play. Partial overspray does not count as completing an object.

steps.text: Clean each of the 16 @item{Retro Thrusters} completely before finishing any other object.

achievements.description: Complete the Wonderland Entrance Hall job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Wonderland Entrance Hall}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Wonderland Entrance Hall} to 100% clean.

achievements.displayName: The Rabbit Sends in a Little Bill
achievements.description: Complete the White Rabbit's House job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{White Rabbit's House}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{White Rabbit's House} to 100% clean.

achievements.description: Complete the Caterpillar's Mushroom job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Caterpillar's Mushroom}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Caterpillar's Mushroom} to 100% clean.

achievements.description: Complete the Mad Tea Party job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Mad Tea Party}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Mad Tea Party} to 100% clean.

achievements.description: Complete the Queen of Hearts' Court job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Queen of Hearts' Court}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Queen of Hearts' Court} to 100% clean.

achievements.displayName: I Really Must be Getting Home
achievements.description: In the Wonderland Entrance Hall, attempt to climb out of the rabbit hole using a ladder
achievements.summary: Climb a ladder toward the rabbit-hole exit in @loc{Wonderland Entrance Hall}.

guide.context: Leaving without the ladder attempt loses this visit; replay @loc{Wonderland Entrance Hall} in Free Play.

steps.text: In the starting pit, place the @item{ladder} against the wall and climb to the top. Jump at the top if the achievement has not unlocked.

achievements.description: In the White Rabbit's House, complete all Clocks on the Clocks Wall first
achievements.summary: Make all 24 @item{Clocks} on the @item{Clocks Wall} the first objects fully cleaned in @loc{White Rabbit's House}.

guide.context: Completing an unrelated object too early fails this attempt; replay @loc{White Rabbit's House} in Free Play. Partial overspray does not count as completing an object.

steps.text: Finish each of the 24 @item{Clocks} on the @item{Clocks Wall} before completing any other object.

achievements.description: In the Caterpillar's Mushroom, clean the Caterpillar's Cocoon last
achievements.summary: Make the @item{Caterpillar's Cocoon} the final object fully cleaned at @loc{Caterpillar's Mushroom}.

guide.context: Completing the cocoon too early fails this attempt; replay @loc{Caterpillar's Mushroom} in Free Play and leave the cocoon until last.

steps.text: Finish every object except the @item{Caterpillar Cocoon}.
Clean the cocoon to finish the job.

achievements.displayName: Like a Tea Tray in the Sky
achievements.description: In the Mad Tea Party, balance on the Strawberry on the topmost cake on the Cake Stand for 10 seconds
achievements.summary: Balance for 10 seconds on the @item{Strawberry} atop the highest cake of the @item{Cake Stand} at @loc{Mad Tea Party}.

guide.context: Leaving without balancing on the strawberry loses this visit; replay @loc{Mad Tea Party} in Free Play.

steps.text: Climb onto the @item{Strawberry} on the highest chocolate cake of the @item{Cake Stand}, then stay on the strawberry for 10 seconds.

achievements.description: In the Queen of Hearts' Court, roll the pink Croquet Ball onto the Croquet Finish Heart
achievements.summary: Roll the pink @item{Croquet Ball} into the @item{Croquet Finish Heart} at @loc{Queen of Hearts' Court}.

guide.context: Leaving without the ball in the hole loses this visit; replay @loc{Queen of Hearts' Court} in Free Play.

steps.text: Find the pink @item{Croquet Ball} to the right of the starting position and roll the ball into the heart-shaped @item{Croquet Finish Heart} hole.

achievements.displayName: A Sacrifice I am Willing to Make
achievements.description: Complete the Duloc job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Duloc}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Duloc} to 100% clean.

achievements.description: Complete the Hansel's Honeymoon Hideaway job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Hansel's Honeymoon Hideaway}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Hansel's Honeymoon Hideaway} to 100% clean.

achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Shrek's Swamp}.

achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Fairy Godmother's Potion Factory}.

achievements.description: Complete the Dragon's Lair job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Dragon's Lair}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Dragon's Lair} to 100% clean.

achievements.description: In the Shrek's Swamp job, clean the Outhouse Door and Outhouse Door Handle first
achievements.summary: Make the @item{Outhouse Door Handle} and @item{Outhouse Door} the first objects fully cleaned at @loc{Shrek's Swamp}.

guide.context: Completing an unrelated object too early fails this attempt; replay @loc{Shrek's Swamp} in Free Play. Partial overspray does not count as completing an object.

steps.text: Finish cleaning the @item{Outhouse Door Handle} and @item{Outhouse Door} before completing any other object.

achievements.description: In the Duloc job, interact with the Information Stand Lever
achievements.summary: Pull the @item{Information Stand Lever} in @loc{Duloc}.

guide.context: Leaving without using the lever loses this visit; replay @loc{Duloc} in Free Play.

steps.text: Interact with the @item{Information Stand Lever} to the right of the main walkway.

achievements.description: In the Hansel's Honeymoon Hideaway job, wait in the Onion Carriage for 30 seconds
achievements.summary: Spend 30 seconds motionless in the @item{Onion Carriage} at @loc{Hansel's Honeymoon Hideaway}.

guide.context: Leaving before waiting in the carriage loses this visit; replay @loc{Hansel's Honeymoon Hideaway} in Free Play.

steps.text: Climb inside the @item{Onion Carriage} and stand still for 30 seconds.

achievements.displayName: Look At Me Shrek, I'm Trotting
achievements.description: In the Fairy Godmother's Potion Factory job, run on the Running Wheel for 20 seconds
achievements.summary: Keep running for 20 seconds on the @item{Running Wheel} at @loc{Fairy Godmother's Potion Factory}.

guide.context: Leaving without using the wheel loses this visit; replay @loc{Fairy Godmother's Potion Factory} in Free Play.

steps.text: Enter the @item{Running Wheel} and keep running on the wheel for 20 seconds.

achievements.description: In the Dragon's Lair job, clean the Gallery Tapestries last
achievements.summary: Make all six @item{Gallery Tapestries} the final objects fully cleaned at @loc{Dragon's Lair}.

guide.context: Completing any tapestry too early fails this attempt; replay @loc{Dragon's Lair} in Free Play and leave all six tapestries until last.

steps.text: Clean every other object, including the two @item{Lair Wall Banners}, while leaving all six @item{Gallery Tapestries} along the walkway unfinished.
Finish the six @item{Gallery Tapestries} to complete the job.

achievements.description: Complete the Wallace & Gromit's Dining Room & Kitchen job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Wallace & Gromit's Dining Room & Kitchen}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Wallace & Gromit's Dining Room & Kitchen} to 100% clean.

achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Wallace & Gromit's House}.

achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Knit-O-Matic}.

achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Wallace & Gromit's Vehicles}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Wallace & Gromit's Vehicles} to 100% clean.

achievements.description: Complete the Moon Rocket job
achievements.summary: Finish cleaning @loc{Moon Rocket}.

steps.text: Bring every part of @loc{Moon Rocket} to 100% clean.

achievements.description: In the Wallace & Gromit's Dining Room & Kitchen job, activate the Toy Train
achievements.summary: Start the @item{Toy Train} at @loc{Wallace & Gromit's Dining Room & Kitchen}.

guide.context: Finishing without starting the train loses this visit; replay @loc{Wallace & Gromit's Dining Room & Kitchen} in Free Play.

steps.text: Interact with the @item{Toy Train} in the kitchen before completing the job.

achievements.description: In the Wallace & Gromit's House job, roll the football under the pond
achievements.summary: Roll the @item{football} into the hole beneath the pond at @loc{Wallace & Gromit's House}.

guide.context: Leaving without the football in the hole loses this visit; replay @loc{Wallace & Gromit's House} in Free Play.

steps.text: Roll the @item{football} toward the house, then past the small @loc{Garden Walkway Runners} gap and onto the pond.
Interact with the pond to flip the pond and drop the football into the hole beneath.

achievements.description: In the Knit-O-Matic job, activate the Auto-Wash
achievements.summary: Start the @item{Auto-Wash} in @loc{Knit-O-Matic}.

guide.context: Finishing without activating Auto-Wash loses this visit; replay @loc{Knit-O-Matic} in Free Play.

steps.text: Interact with the @item{Auto-Wash} before completing @loc{Knit-O-Matic}.

achievements.description: In the Wallace & Gromit's Vehicles job, clean the Techno Trousers first
achievements.summary: Fully clean every @item{Techno Trousers} component before any unrelated object at @loc{Wallace & Gromit's Vehicles}.

guide.context: Completing an unrelated object too early fails this attempt; replay @loc{Wallace & Gromit's Vehicles} in Free Play. Partial overspray does not count as completing an object.

steps.text: Clean only @item{Techno Trousers} parts until every component is finished: Body, Boots, Braces Holders, Operator Controls, Interior Padding, Leg Hydraulics, Loading Hooks, Panel, Rubberised Ankles, Rubberised Legs and Socket Cover.

achievements.description: In the Moon Rocket job, clean the paintings inside the rocket first
achievements.summary: Make all five @item{Rocket Interior Paintings} the first objects fully cleaned at @loc{Moon Rocket}.

guide.context: Completing an unrelated object too early fails this attempt; replay @loc{Moon Rocket} in Free Play. Partial overspray does not count as completing an object.

steps.text: Go inside the rocket and finish cleaning all five @item{Rocket Interior Paintings} before completing any other object.
